title: settings_load_at reads the entire dotfile before any size bound
evidence:
data, err := os.read_entire_file_from_path(path, context.temp_allocator)
	if err != nil || len(data) < 6 {
detail: A multi-gigabyte HOME dotfile is slurped before the length check; only len<6 is rejected. Local single-user file, low severity.
recommended_fix: Stat first and cap the read (e.g. skip files > 4KB) or stream the 6 header bytes.

title: settings_save_at writes via a predictable '<path>.tmp' without O_EXCL, then renames over the target
evidence_note: second line reads: tmp := strings.concatenate({path, ".tmp"}, context.temp_allocator); write_entire_file(tmp); os.rename(tmp, path)
detail: A pre-placed symlink at ~/.pp-settings.bin.tmp redirects the write (and the follow-up rename clobbers the symlink target). Local single-user game — low risk.
recommended_fix: Use an mkstemp-style unique temp name or open with O_CREAT|O_EXCL before writing.
carry: still present since round 5 (introduced with settings.odin in r1 chunk-app; chunk-rest lenses never reviewed it)
